title: Vivid BAD SQUAD Chapter1 Episode19 Distinction

rows.Speaker: Little Toya
rows.Line: Huh? I was out playing with a friend.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line:
Stop wasting your time on such trivial things.
Now go get ready. You're going to practice late again today.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: Doesn't matter. You're not stopping until you can play it.

rows.Speaker: Little Toya
rows.Line:
Why am I not allowed to go play with my friends?
Why do I have to practice piano and violin even on the weekends?

rows.Speaker: Toya's Mother
rows.Line: You're actually very lucky, Toya. There aren't many people who are able to take private lessons on a daily basis from a top class musician like your father.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Mother
rows.Line: He taught your brothers as well, and they've all been getting top marks in their competitions.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Mother
rows.Line: Your father turned down an offer from overseas so he could stay here and teach you, you know. You have to work extra hard to thank him.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Before I realized it, I started hating everything about music.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And to get back at my dad, I quit playing both the piano and the violin.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: To be honest, I would have been fine with anything, as long as he was against it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: The only reason I started playing non-classical music here was because I thought it would be the best way to make him angry. It was childish of me.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Now I'm really interested.
Hey, how would you like to try singing together?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
This is Ken.
He's one of the guys who helped organize RAD WEEKEND!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: One of these days we're going to put on an event as amazing as that one, Toya!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: He taught me all about this town and how to enjoy music again. He even...shared his dream with me.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito was my first true friend.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But he's always got his sights set straight ahead...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: If I stay with him, I'll just keep him from realizing his dream.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Even when I'm right next to him, I just can't see the same thing he does.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: The only reason I stuck with him for long...is because I was too scared to face the truth.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: In the end, I had the weakest resolve of anyone.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I've been thinking about it for a while now.
Having someone like me beside him will only get in his way.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What Akito really needs are people like you, Shiraishi, Azusawa. People who are serious about chasing their dream of surpassing RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
You two are the same as him.
You're able to keep moving forward because you believe in the path you chose.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Your singing showed me that.
It also made me realize that I don't have the same resolve.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That's why I've finally made the decision to stop acting like a child and relying on Akito.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Toya, can you do one more thing before you leave?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: It seems there's still someone here who hasn't accepted your decision. Would you mind talking to them?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
I think this is my cue to make myself scarce.
An, would you keep an eye on things?
